description: This dataset provides ice temperature profiles in Antarctica derived from SMOS observations, along with the associated quality flag. The retrieval is based on a minimization between observed and simulated brightness temperatures. The snow and ice emission model uses as input ice temperature profiles simulated with the one-dimensional ice sheet model from Robin (1955). The Robin model takes as inputs ice thickness, surface temperature, geothermal heat flux, and mean annual accumulation, and allows estimation of ice temperature where ice velocity is lower than 10 m yr-1. The methodology is described in Macelloni et al. 2019 (https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rse.2019.111405). The dataset is static, as internal ice sheet temperature is not expected to change on a centennial timescale. It is georeferenced on the EASEGrid2 projection (EPSG:6932) with a spatial resolution of 25 m x 25 km and is available at: https://data.catds.fr/cecsm/Cryo_products/IceSheet_InternalTemperature.
title: Internal ice-sheet temperature_Antarctica_SMOS
